description: Process step 3: 'Uncovered acceptance criteria: any acceptance criterion not traceable to a check or a human gate in done-contract.md's own Coverage table' is a CRITICAL finding. Guards against rush-analyze missing a done-contract.md that silently drops an acceptance criterion.

given.scenario: Run /rush-analyze against the fixture feature whose done-contract.md declares 3 acceptance criteria but whose own coverage table only traces criteria 1 and 2 — criterion 3 ('unauthenticated caller returns 401') maps to nothing.

graders.rubric: PASS only if the verdict is NO-GO with a numbered CRITICAL blocker (or, at minimum, an explicitly recorded WARNING if the reviewer judges it non-blocking on its own — but never silence) that specifically names done-contract.md's acceptance criterion 3 as untraceable to any check or human_gate in its own Coverage table. FAIL if the verdict is GO; FAIL if NO-GO is reached for other reasons but this specific gap is never mentioned anywhere in the report.
